steps.text: Open the dossier the piece has to be attached to.
steps.title: Open the dossier

steps.text: A document produced outside OptimCE — a signed form, a letter from the grid operator — is declared here first, then receives its file.
steps.title: Declare the piece

steps.text: Choose the type of document to add to the dossier.
steps.title: Document type

steps.text: Pick the matching form and give it a title your colleagues will recognise.
steps.title: Name the piece

steps.text: Submit to create the document in the dossier.
steps.title: Create the document

steps.text: The upload icon lets you attach your own file instead of having OptimCE generate one.
steps.title: Upload a version

steps.text: Drop the file in the dedicated area, or click to pick it from your computer.
steps.title: Choose the file

steps.text: Every upload creates one more permanent version. A file already stored is never replaced: it is kept, and the new one becomes the current version.
steps.title: Store it

steps.text: The document now has a downloadable version, exactly as if it had been generated.
steps.title: The piece is attached

steps.text: Open the versions to confirm the file was stored, with its original name and size.
steps.title: Check the history

steps.text: The uploaded file shows up as version 1. Unlike a generated version it keeps no data snapshot: an arbitrary file says nothing about who it concerns.
steps.title: One more version

steps.text: Close the window when you are done.
steps.title: Close

title: Attach a document you already have
